# Tasks & Todo Outline: CarouselTwelve (carousel-twelve)

## Overview

Recreation of ColorLib Carousel V12 as a modern React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + TypeScript template named **CarouselTwelve** (`carousel-twelve`).

## Section breakdown & Implementation plan

1. **Navbar (`Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Sticky header with backdrop blur, responsive mobile menu toggle, navigation links, and primary CTA.
2. **Hero (`Hero.tsx`)**:
   - Clean split layout or centered display with prominent headline, badge, CTA buttons, and high-quality Picsum image.
3. **Product Carousel (`ProductCarousel.tsx`)**:
   - Interactive carousel supporting slide navigation, pagination dots, product cards with images, pricing, ratings, and action buttons.
4. **Features Grid (`Features.tsx`)**:
   - 3-column grid featuring Lucide icons, titles, and descriptive blurbs.
5. **Testimonials (`Testimonials.tsx`)**:
   - Grid or carousel of customer feedback cards with star ratings and user avatars.
6. **Footer (`Footer.tsx`)**:
   - Multi-column link layout, newsletter signup form, social links, and mandatory `https://www.componentdock.com/` attribution.

## Fidelity Notes

- **Source**: ColorLib Carousel V12 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-12/`).
- **Design Aesthetic**: Clean, product-focused showcase with smooth interactive carousel mechanics, modern card styling, and professional typography.
- **Images**: Sourced via deterministic Unsplash/Picsum seeds (`https://picsum.photos/seed/carousel-twelve-<id>/...`).
